name: paper
title: Paper texture
description: A paper height field lit by a raking light that circles slowly. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

props.name: paper
props.doc: The colour of the sheet where the light is full.

props.name: shade
props.doc: The colour of the sheet in its shadows and blotches.

props.name: fibre
props.doc: How much fibre shows. 0 is smooth stock; 1 is a handmade sheet.

props.name: relief
props.doc: How strongly the light picks out the surface. Higher is rougher.

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size of the texture: higher is coarser.

props.name: speed
props.doc: How fast the light moves. Whole numbers loop seamlessly over 10 seconds.

props.name: falloff
props.doc: How much darker the far side of the sheet is.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Extra grain over the whole frame.
